description:
The annual spring Brahmotsavams are celebrated for 15 days, starting from Ugadi. The 2026 schedule spanned from 19 March to 2 April 2026.
NOTE: During the annual Brahmotsavams (19-03-2026 to 02-04-2026), regular daily Nitya Kalyanams, Homams, and other private Arjitha Sevas are suspended.
importance: Major annual spring festival featuring Sree Seetha Ramachandra Swamy Thiru Kalyanotsavam (on Sri Rama Navami) where the Government of Telangana officially presents Mutyala Talambralu (pearls) and silk clothes on behalf of the state, Sree Maha Pattabhishekam (Coronation ceremony), Divya Vimana Rathotsavam, Teppotsavam, and other key rituals.

schedule_2026.details: Ankurarpanam & Agni Prathistha (Seed sowing and fire invocation).
Dhwajarohanam (Hoisting of the sacred Garuda flag to initiate the festival).
Kurmavataram Alankaram & Sri Sesha Vahana Seva.
Varahavataram Alankaram & Sri Hamsa Vahana Seva.
Sri Krishna Alankaram & Sri Simha Vahana Seva.
Edurukolu Mahotsavam (The traditional welcoming ceremony between the bridegroom and bride's families).

Sree Seetha Ramachandra Swamy Thiru Kalyanotsavam (The celestial wedding of Lord Sri Rama and Goddess Seetha, celebrated in the Mithila Stadium). The Government of Telangana officially presents Mutyala Talambralu (pearls) and silk clothes on behalf of the state.
Sree Maha Pattabhishekam (The grand Coronation ceremony of Lord Sri Rama).
Divya Vimana Rathotsavam (The grand chariot procession carrying the deities).
Teppotsavam (Swan boat festival in Godavari River).
Maha Purnahuti, followed by Chakra Teertham (Holy immersion in Godavari River).
Pushpayagam (Offering of flowers to the deities).
Shataghata Abhishekam, followed by Dolotsavam (Swing festival) & Official Conclusion.

description:
Vaikuntha Ekadashi (Mukkoti Ekadashi) is observed on Sunday, 20 December 2026.
Teppotsavam (Float Festival): Celebrated on Dashami evening (19 December 2026). The deities are taken in a colorful procession on a swan-shaped boat (Hamsa Vahanam) in the Godavari River, accompanied by fireworks.
Uttara Dwara Darshanam: Opens at dawn (around 5:00 AM) on Ekadashi morning (20 December 2026). Devotees enter through the Northern Gate, representing entry into Vaikuntha.
Mukkoti Dwadashi Dwara Darshanam: Observed on the following day with special offerings and distribution of holy prasadam.
importance: Major festival where pilgrims enter through Uttara Dwara (Northern Gate) representing entry into Vaikuntha, preceded by Teppotsavam on Dashami evening and followed by Mukkoti Dwadashi Dwara Darshanam.

description: Held annually in January (on Purvabhadra Nakshatram in Pushya Masam) to honor Bhakta Ramadasu. Vocalists and musicians gather to perform Gosthi Gana Sankeerthana of Ramadasu's Navaratna Keerthanas.
importance: Musical and devotional festival honoring Bhakta Ramadasu with Gosthi Gana Sankeerthana of his Navaratna Keerthanas.
